task.title: Persist workflow-run starts with immutable topology provenance
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/688 under decision https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/687 by starting one durable workflow run from an owned topology snapshot that can replay without a registry.
acceptance_criteria: Store each exact non-blank run ID in its own event stream and reject duplicate starts atomically.
Persist one strict version-one start event containing exact workflow identity, authored phases, transitions, gates, and start topology.
Load the immutable workflow snapshot and exact starting phase without consulting a registry, package, manifest, or filesystem.
Reject malformed payloads, unsupported events, invalid topology, and impossible history without returning partial state or granting execution authority.

attempts.summary: Established RED durable workflow-run coverage before adding production APIs.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow_run_store test target failed because durable workflow-run identity, start, load, projection, and replay contracts did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact start projection, duplicate atomicity, reopen without a registry, malformed payloads, unsupported events, and invalid history.

attempts.summary: Implemented strict start-event persistence and registry-free replay.
attempts.diagnostic: Owning the complete validated topology in the first event made the durable aggregate independent of later registry or extension changes.
attempts.patch: Added workflow-run IDs, snapshots, version-one event encoding, start and load operations, typed errors, ADR-0009, and milestone documentation.

attempts.summary: Addressed substantive review feedback without changing the replay contract.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found a redundant validated workflow-to-snapshot reconstruction during decode, but classified it as a trivial performance nit with no correctness impact.
attempts.patch: Retained the already-decoded owned snapshot after validation, reran focused and repository verification, and preserved incremental review coverage through final head 1229001488a5df0ed9992722dc653536840bebe9.

outcome.summary: Durable workflow runs now begin from one immutable owned topology snapshot and replay their exact starting state without ambient registry authority.

lessons: A durable aggregate needs owned immutable definition provenance rather than a reference to mutable process-local registry state.
Revalidating start resolution during replay prevents malformed persisted topology from becoming partial state.
Exact per-run streams make duplicate creation an atomic expected-version decision.
Review-driven simplification can remove redundant replay work without broadening the durable state contract.
Starting and loading state grants no transition, gate, action, provider, tool, scheduling, or permission authority.
